column3: A huge armoured man stands firmly planted with both feet in place and a shield on his left arm, raises a long heavy hammer overhead with his right arm, then smashes it straight down in front of him, bending at the knees, feet not moving, then holds perfectly still.
A huge armoured man stands in place, raises a long heavy hammer overhead in his right hand and shakes it triumphantly, feet planted, then lowers it and holds a proud still stance.
A slender woman stands in place holding a bow in her left hand, raises the bow overhead with a bright smile, feet planted, bounces on her toes once, then holds the pose.
A slender woman holding a bow stands in place, is hit hard in the chest, her knees buckle straight down, she crumples to the ground where she stands, curls on her side and lies perfectly still.

A huge heavy armoured man stands braced in place, is hit hard in the chest, his knees give way, he drops heavily to both knees where he stands, topples forward onto his chest and lies completely still.
